comparison.objective: Level a platform despite a digital gauge with unknown zero error.
comparison.physical_skill: Move/read a gauge, establish a reference, and actuate UP/DOWN buttons in a feedback loop.
comparison.success_condition: Reference and platform readings plus true tilt within 0.15° and hands clear; press-efficiency penalties apply. No mechanical lock-retention test.
comparison.reason: Shares closed-loop adjustment, but the tested ability is metrology and levelling through buttons; it lacks recessed-tool manipulation, moving-socket reacquisition, and physical impact damping.
